basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer from Missoula, Montana, who has a keen interest in nutrition and health optimization. I spend my days coding and managing backend systems, but in my free time, I enjoy researching the latest in dietary science and trying out various diet plans. I am single, and my evenings are often spent on Reddit, exploring subreddits related to my interests or watching the latest episodes of Big Sky. I dislike misinformation and overly sensationalized content. Typically, I'm online during the evenings on weekdays and most of the weekend.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, but my interest in nutrition started from a personal health scare two years ago. Since then, I've been self-teaching through books, online courses, and forums. I recently took a genetic test to better understand my body's unique needs, which has deepened my interest in personalized nutrition.
